headword: {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}
gloss: demonstration experiment; proof-of-concept test; field trial

definitions.gloss: demonstration experiment; proof-of-concept test; field trial
definitions.explanation: A practical experiment conducted to verify the feasibility or effectiveness of a new technology, system, or method in real-world conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動運転|じどううんてん}→自動運転：06451_jidouunten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: A field trial for autonomous driving has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The city is conducting a proof-of-concept test for a new transportation system.

examples.japanese: {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}まえて→踏まえる：07701_fumaeru⟧、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: Based on the results of the field trial, full-scale implementation is planned for next year.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{実証|じっしょう}→実証：12350_jisshou⟧ (demonstration, empirical proof) + ⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧ (experiment). A widely used term in news and business for testing new technologies, services, and systems before full-scale deployment. Common in transportation, energy, agriculture, and IT contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ — conduct a field trial
- {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}する→開始する：26826_kaishisuru⟧ — start a demonstration experiment
- {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ — results of the trial
- ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧{実証実験|じっしょうじっけん} — large-scale field trial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧ — experiment; more general, including laboratory experiments
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ — test, trial; broader term that also covers exams and product testing
- ⟦パイロット→パイロット：00339_pairotto⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧ — pilot project; similar concept but emphasizes the business/project aspect rather than the experimental verification
